rule-7877c000c080d739794dbb3915705fc9502.judgment: Guarded recursive equation of trialChoice for a divisor; it increments I and changes the carried result to Y.

rule-8c56ab5c7a8fcd164fb0d555a596cba2218.judgment: Guarded recursive equation of trialChoice for a non-divisor; it increments I and preserves the carried result.

rule-9fda901ff7675dee4a02c075bdb95e6d8c0.judgment: Disjoint recursive-summary branch of xOrYSpec for N >= 2; it starts trialChoice at divisor 2 with X carried.

rule-a0b42dd3540472c0a1673da37721faef739.judgment: Disjoint base branch of the named xOrYSpec summary for N < 2.

rule-cfb2314df4ea697cded9cf0262c9f914879.judgment: Guarded base equation of the named trialChoice recurrence; it returns the carried result after the scan reaches N.

mathematical_note: For N >= 2, trialChoice scans exactly 2 through N-1, changing the carried value from X to Y iff a divisor is encountered. Thus the summary returns X exactly when that range contains no divisor; for N < 2, xOrYSpec returns Y directly.
